what: Each card gets one tilt angle picked at random when it is attached (50/50 either -2.5 to -.5° or .5 to 2.5° — values near 0 are skipped), and on wide screens hovering tilts it to that angle while growing 1.02x (.15s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)). A three-column text card grid where every card is picked up with a different feel

options.--fx-rotate: Angle the part sets — if fixed via style, that angle applies

note: Tilts only at 1024px and up (original lg:hover — no hover-device condition). The shadow change is handled by the inner card.

from.where: blog.html .am-post — the original blog card (in useEffect, 2·rand is split half and half into -2.5/+.5 for --rotate, lg:hover:scale-[1.02] rotate-[var(--rotate)], transition box-shadow·transform 150ms)

On all pages .se-ph (cut-out photo) — the original img:not(.not-animated):hover rotate(-3deg) transition transform .2s ease (992px and up, hover devices). With this part: style="--fx-rotate: -3deg; --fx-scale: 1; --fx-dur: .2s; --fx-ease: ease"
